changelog.title: Plugin-Site Relationships
changes: 🔗 Many-to-many plugin-site linking with bulk update API
📦 Plugin cards show linked sites with badges
🌐 Site cards show linked plugins
📝 Remote slug configuration in mapping dialog
🔄 Full CRUD for plugin mappings (create, update, delete)
knownIssues: Hosted Lovable preview cannot connect to localhost backend - use http://localhost:8080 locally

changelog.title: Site UI Improvements & Connection Persistence
changes: 📑 Tabbed Site dialog (Basic + Connection tabs) for reduced scrolling
✅ Green 'Connected' badge persists after successful connection test
🔄 Retest button on connected sites for manual refresh
💾 Save button always visible (test optional but recommended)
🎨 Improved site cards with status badges and action buttons
knownIssues: Hosted Lovable preview cannot connect to localhost backend - use http://localhost:8080 locally

changelog.title: API Connectivity & Diagnostics Fix
changes: 🔧 Backend health endpoint now returns standard envelope format
📡 Added GET /api/v1 index endpoint (prevents 404 on base URL)
🔍 BackendStatus detection logic fixed: 2xx JSON = connected
📋 Enhanced diagnostics: shows raw env vars + resolved URLs
📖 Error modal now displays UI origin, API base (absolute), raw VITE env vars
knownIssues: Hosted Lovable preview cannot connect to localhost backend - use http://localhost:8080 locally

changelog.title: Diagnostics & About Panel
changes: 🛠️ Copy Diagnostics button for quick support info
ℹ️ About panel in Settings with app/script versions
🔧 Build metadata (git commit, build time) in version.json
📋 Backend now logs app name + version at startup

changelog.title: Version Tracking & Error Improvements
